mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studenthomework WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studenthomework WHERE status = 2
SELECT ROUND(AVG(score), 1) FROM studenthomework WHERE status = 2 AND score IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.coursename AS name, COUNT(h.homeworkid) AS value FROM course c LEFT JOIN homework h ON h.courseid = c.courseid GROUP BY c.courseid, c.coursename HAVING value > 0 ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT seg AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN score >= 90 THEN '优秀(90-100)' WHEN score >= 80 THEN '良好(80-89)' WHEN score >= 70 THEN '中等(70-79)' WHEN score >= 60 THEN '及格(60-69)' ELSE '不及格(60以下)' END AS seg FROM studenthomework WHERE status = 2 AND score IS NOT NULL ) t GROUP BY seg

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(submittime, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM studenthomework WHERE submittime IS NOT NULL AND submittime >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(submittime, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT c.coursename AS name, ROUND(AVG(sh.score), 1) AS value FROM studenthomework sh JOIN homework h ON sh.homeworkid = h.homeworkid JOIN course c ON h.courseid = c.courseid WHERE sh.status = 2 AND sh.score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.courseid, c.coursename ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT m.majorname AS name, COUNT(s.studentid) AS value FROM major m LEFT JOIN student s ON s.majorid = m.majorid GROUP BY m.majorid, m.majorname HAVING value > 0 ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalExplains, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(duration)), 0) AS avgDuration, IFNULL(SUM(is_cache_hit), 0) AS cacheHits FROM ai_explain_log

SELECT t.teachername AS name, COUNT(c.courseid) AS value FROM teacher t LEFT JOIN course c ON c.teacherid = t.teacherid GROUP BY t.teacherid, t.teachername HAVING value > 0 ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}
